data_source_notes.VT: Vanguard Total World Stock ETF. Added 2026-08-04 at the user's request. Unlike every earlier addition, no broker instrument search was run for VT before it was whitelisted -- the session that added it had no Robinhood access -- so state/tradeable/fractional_tradability/prior-close availability are UNVERIFIED. No new code path trusts this: the existing preflight and data-confidence gates resolve VT at run time and gate it out fail-closed if it does not resolve, exactly as they would for any other symbol. Confirm resolution on the first live run before treating VT as a normal member of the universe. Robinhood is the primary data source: resolved active, tradeable=true, fractional_tradability='tradable', regular-hours dollar orders supported, prior close available. Finance connector ticker lookup returned NOT_FOUND, so finance data may be unresolved/unavailable for GFUZ.

whole_share_reasons.RVII: Moved out of 'active' into 'whole_share' on 2026-08-24 at the owner's explicit request: RVII is not purchasable in fractional/notional dollar amounts, so its normal $1-$10 graded-ladder buy would always be blocked at the is_tradable_for_fractional_buy gate exactly like BYDDY's. It keeps being evaluated by the same graded ladder as the active universe (it still appears in signals.csv like any other symbol) and is still purchased along with the regular buys -- only the ORDER MECHANISM changes: each day's would-be buy accumulates in the durable whole-share ledger and a single whole-share (quantity-based) order fires once the accumulated total reaches one share's price. As with its original 2026-08-16 addition, no in-repo Robinhood instrument search was run for RVII -- the run-time preflight and data-confidence gates still admit or gate it out fail-closed. RVII already carries a $1.00/$1.00 config/per_ticker_sizing.json base (global fallback ladder, no calibrated history), which is what the whole-share path requires. NOTE (added on review the same day): at ~$23.36/share RVII is priced ABOVE circuit_breakers.max_per_order_usd ($10), which would have blocked its fire outright forever -- a whole-share ticker has no unit smaller than one share, so that ceiling reads as 'never buy'. config/budgets.json's circuit_breakers.whole_share_max_per_order_usd ($50) is the allowance that authorizes exactly that one share. See docs/whole_share_accumulation.md.
whole_share_reasons.BYDDY: Not tradable for fractional/notional buys on Robinhood (fractional_tradability != 'tradable'), so the normal $1-$10 graded-ladder buy would always be blocked at the is_tradable_for_fractional_buy gate. Evaluated by the same graded ladder as the active universe -- purchased along with the regular buys -- but routed through the whole-share accumulation path instead: each day's would-be buy accumulates in a durable ledger, and a single whole-share (quantity-based) order fires once the total reaches one share's price. See docs/whole_share_accumulation.md.

whole_share_note: 'excluded' is reserved for a ticker with NO buying mechanism at all (e.g. a delisting/wind-down); a 'whole_share' ticker is never 'excluded' since it IS actively bought, just via a different mechanism -- see 'active', 'excluded', and 'whole_share' above: every symbol in this universe is in exactly one of the three.

GFUZ.reason: Finance (and other read-only market-data providers) may not resolve GFUZ. Robinhood is the primary quote/prior-close source for GFUZ; Alpaca/Finance/Yahoo remain read-only validation/context only.

supplemental_preflight.trigger: If the same-day 9:45 pre-flight artifact does not contain a GFUZ row (e.g. GFUZ was unresolved at 9:45), the 10:30 live task should run a supplemental GFUZ read-only validation before decisioning.
supplemental_preflight.note: Persist the supplemental read-only validation to gfuz_supplemental_preflight.json before any GFUZ signal/budget/order decisioning; the decision engine reads only from the persisted file.
supplemental_preflight.implementation_status: not_implemented: MorningDCAExecutor._apply_preflight_gate() has no code path for this today. A missing GFUZ row in the 9:45 preflight artifact simply gates GFUZ out (tickers ∩ eligible_tickers excludes it) for that run, a safe, fail-closed degradation, not the supplemental-validation flow described above. See config/morning_dca.json's gfuz_special_handling.supplemental_preflight.implementation_status for the authoritative note.
